config.protocol: Two paired arms, fixed versus supervised context Transformer; same initialization, lexical head, examples, order and epoch budget. Phase is frozen. No test-driven tuning. Fit marginal temperature on the next document fold per language. All ten held-out folds are evaluated once. Training is capped by whole document groups: a capacity-limited CV pilot, not a full-data or official CoNLL test score.

sources.tokenization: UD surface tokens (MWT rows replace components); whitespace gaps are separate exact spans

partition.limitations: Parallel translated text; custom grouped CV, not the official CoNLL test. No semantic near-duplicate detection beyond source-document/translation IDs and normalized exact text.
